subject: Consultancy co-delivery: Pinecone + S3 triage and kickoff
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@northstarlabs.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie@pinecone.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consultancy co-delivery: Pinecone + S3 triage and kickoff

Hi Alex / Jamie —

Thanks again for the intro, Alex. Per our call last week, NorthStar is lined up to help deliver a joint PoC for Acme Retail: Pinecone for vector serving with S3 cold-fallthrough for long-term storage and reprovisioned shards. I wanted to kick off a short triage thread to surface technical constraints, ownership, and an initial timeline so we can get procurement what they need.

High-level asks for this thread:
- Confirm NorthStar scope (data ingestion, embedding pipeline tweaks, deployment runbooks)
- Confirm Pinecone support level and any connector code we should rely on
- Identify Redwood owners for: integration engineering, infra runbooks, and CS enablement
- Agree on PoC success criteria and a target 6-week window

We attached a one-page draft scope and an onboarding checklist to make initial handoffs easier (co-delivery_scope_v1.pdf, onboarding_checklist.xlsx).

Suggested owners from our side:
- Mina Haddad (partner technical PM) — myself
- Ben Carter (platform eng) — infra and connector changes
- Vanessa Ortiz (partner GTM) — field enablement and commercial cadence

Alex — can you confirm NorthStar's delivery milestones and whether you need us to own any of the ingestion pieces? Jamie — any Pinecone constraints we should call out (shard limits, replication windows, pre-warming suggestions)?

Proposed immediate next step: 30-minute triage today or tomorrow to align owners and produce a short mutual action plan. I can host — what times work for you both?

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Partner Technical PM | Redwood Inference
Attachment: co-delivery_scope_v1.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: onboarding_checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Alex Mercer <alex@northstarlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie@pinecone.io>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultancy co-delivery: Pinecone + S3 triage and kickoff

Thanks Mina — sounds good. NorthStar can take the ingestion and feature-store mapping work for the PoC. Tentative milestones from our side: 2 weeks to wire ingestion + embeddings adapter, 2 weeks to validate recall/latency with Pinecone, 2 weeks for scale and runbook handoff.

A couple of quick Qs:
- Will Redwood provide a temporary Pinecone test instance or should NorthStar procure one?
- For S3 fallthrough, do you expect a custom lifecycle to be built (we can deliver) or leverage your existing S3 connector?

We have availability today 2–4pm PT or tomorrow morning 9–11am PT. Happy to take the triage and then produce a short MAP.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
Director, Solutions — NorthStar Labs
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex@northstarlabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Jamie Lee <jamie@pinecone.io>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultancy co-delivery: Pinecone + S3 triage and kickoff

Mina / team —

+1 to Alex's timeline. Quick notes from infra perspective:
- We can provide a short-lived Pinecone sandbox (dev tier) for the PoC; we'll need Jamie to confirm feature parity for replication/ttl.
- For S3 fallthrough: Redwood has an existing connector that handles prefix-level read-through and async spillover. We should decide whether NorthStar wants us to run the connector or hand over a runbook so they can manage it during the PoC. Managing it gives us better visibility for final handoff.
- Ops: I'll loop Connor for runbook creation and deployment automation.

Connor — can you add a short template for runbooks (playbooks for failover, cache warming, and reindex steps) and drop it here?

Ben Carter
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consultancy co-delivery: Pinecone + S3 triage and kickoff

Thanks all — good alignment. Quick answers and the agenda for the 30-minute triage tomorrow at 9:30am PT (booked via calendar invite).

Quick answers:
- Pinecone sandbox: Redwood will spin up a dev instance and invite NorthStar; Jamie, I'll need an email for access (Alex's is fine).
- S3 fallthrough: let's use Redwood's connector for the PoC so we can collect metrics and iterate quickly; NorthStar can shadow and then take over ops on handoff if preferred.

Agenda (30min):
1) Confirm owners & contact points (1 min)
2) PoC milestones + responsibilities (8 min)
3) Integration details: Pinecone config (replication/replicas), S3 lifecycle and object layout, ingestion pipeline touchpoints (10 min)
4) Success criteria & data needs (5 min)
5) Immediate next steps & docs (6 min)

Deliverables after triage: short MAP doc, access list, and a runbook template (Ben / Connor). I'll drop the MAP into the shared Redwood drive and post the link here.

Attachments: co-delivery_scope_v1.pdf, onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Mina Haddad
Partner Technical PM | Redwood Inference
